status: PASS: final saved outputs and repaired phase boundary; original failure preserved
scientific_core_findings: All Kumar main arms share explicit H21 orthonormal CAR coordinates, MNE CSP4 with Ledoit-Wolf regularization and full rank, and LDA with lsqr/automatic shrinkage. The support-derived reference is fixed during prediction.

BNCI retains the original 22-coordinate prepared inputs and fixed 0.1 CSP/LDA core. Direct comparison of all nine Full and nine EA saved prediction vectors found no differences from the historical results.
The diagonal reference is defined in a fixed coordinate basis. Full covariance EA and diagonal arms share the remaining core estimation choices.
RMS normalization uses one scalar per trial, independently for source, support and query; it estimates no query-batch reference.
Class order is 0=left and 1=right. Balanced NLL with clipping at 1e-7 and single-coordinate binary Brier were independently verified from actual saved probabilities.
Only the anticipated np.linalg.LinAlgError raised by fit is classified as a scientific failed attempt. Prediction, state, storage, hash and unexpected errors propagate.

original_boundary_and_resolution.original_issue: A nonempty one-class query incorrectly entered the historical-prediction join. Run01 stopped before claiming that cell, after 362 completed fits.
original_boundary_and_resolution.repaired_scope: The original Full phase status and support/query IDs and counts are checked before fitting. All 32 undefined statuses are retained without fit claims.

runtime_accounting.implementation_boundary: The runner checks a per-process monotonic clock, which is reset on manual resume. This audit verifies actual elapsed time from the first dispatch; it does not establish a persistent cross-process deadline guard.
